test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Despite facing numerous challenges, the team successfully _________________ the project ahead of schedule.
solution:
The correct answer is '**completed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is written in the past tense, which requires the verb form "**completed**" to match the context of a past action.
 
• The phrase "Despite facing numerous challenges" suggests a completed action, and the simple past tense "**completed**" is the most appropriate choice here.
 
• Options like "**had completed**", "**has been completed**", and "**will be completed**" do not fit the past tense context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Despite facing numerous challenges, the team successfully **completed**__ the project ahead of schedule."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "had completed**" is past perfect tense, which is used when one past action happens before another past action. This doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "has been completed**" is present perfect passive, which is not appropriate for this sentence's past tense context.
 
• **Option 4: "will be completed**" is future tense, which is not suitable for describing a completed action in the past.
